title: LieAbility
tagline: Verify authenticity in interviews using facial, speech, and cryptographic analysis.
description: Lie Ability is a web app that verifies the authenticity of human interactions—starting with job interviews. Using facial expression analysis, speech sentiment, and ZKProof truth validation, we generate a Trust Score after each interaction. Interviewees answer behavioral questions while being recorded; our system then analyzes emotional alignment, verbal confidence, and claim verifiability (via ZKProofs). As trust erodes in a digital world filled with deepfakes and AI-generated content, Lie Ability brings back credibility—empowering recruiters, teams, and individuals to understand not just what someone says, but how genuinely they say it. Don’t hire a liability—use Lie Ability.
how_its_made:
Frontend: 
- Tailwind CSS
- Framer Motion
- Shadcn/UI
- MetaMask Integration: For wallet connectivity to mint NFTs
Backend
- Express.js
- OpenCV: For facial recognition and expressions analysis 
- OpenAI Whisper: For accurate speech-to-text transcription and analysis 
Blockchain
- Hedera Blockchain: Used for NFT issuance and verification
- Hedera SDK: For direct interaction with the Hedera network
- ERC-721 Smart Contract: For NFT implementation
